    pb.pwrbatteqref AS equipment_code,
    pb.energyefficiencypercent,
    pb.powersource,
    ROUND(CAST(

            WHEN pb.powersource IN ('Solar', 'Wind') THEN 1.5
            WHEN pb.powersource = 'Hybrid' THEN 1.2

        (ww.waterlevelpercent / 100.0) * (CAST(ww.waterqualityindex AS numeric) / 100.0) * (1.0 - ww.wastetanklevelpercent / 100.0) AS numeric), 4) AS wrmi
FROM powerbattery pb
JOIN waterandwaste ww ON pb.pwrbatteqref = ww.watereqref;
